baseline.description: A perturbation changes expression by the sum of its genes' single-gene changes in training (additive model).

lineage.hypothesis: Warm start: the best model of run norman_control_replogle_w4_r0 (EXP_0198, visible 0.6423) is the starting point of this run.
Add additive_singles_e15_e8 to the best model (EXP_0007): it helped elsewhere and the best model lacks it.
The sign-flipped Replogle CRISPRi delta of gene g (not the target) captures the gene's intrinsic responsiveness to perturbations and improves predictions.

most_useful_features.description: For each target gene of a perturbation p, the leave-one-out mean training delta profile of that gene across all training perturbations containing it, summed over p's targets.
KNN-weighted average of training deltas over perturbations with similar target-gene profiles.
Sum of sign-flipped Replogle2022_K562 CRISPRi deltas for the perturbation's target genes.
Average control-cell co-expression correlation between gene g and the target gene(s) of perturbation p.
For a pair p=(A,B), the departure of its training delta from the sum of the single-gene deltas of A and B; averaged over training pairs sharing a target.
Sign-flipped Replogle2022_K562 CRISPRi delta of the predicted gene g itself, identical for all perturbations.

Mean leave-one-out training delta of PPI neighbors of gene g under perturbation p, weighted by PPI edge weight; falls back to additive single-gene predictions for unseen perturbations or unmeasured neighbors.
Mean PPI edge weight between each target of p and gene g, averaged over targets.
Average PPI degree of the perturbation's target genes.
Average over p's targets of (PPI degree of target) * |sign-flipped Replogle delta of target|.
